summary: Closes two kernel handles guarded by per-handle validity flags. First: if flag at this+0x24 is non-zero and CloseHandle on the handle at this+0x1C succeeds, clear the handle field to 0. Second: if flag at this+0x14 is non-zero and CloseHandle on the handle at this+0xC succeeds, clear that handle field to 0. Returns the result of the second CloseHandle attempt.

operations.description: First handle is only closed when the validity flag at this+0x24 is non-zero.
Call CloseHandle (imported via global at 0x0059E1A8) on the first handle at this+0x1C; the returned success value gates the field clear.
Clear the first handle field at this+0x1C to 0 when the CloseHandle call succeeds.
Second handle is only closed when the validity flag at this+0x14 is non-zero.
Call CloseHandle (imported via global at 0x0059E1A8) on the second handle at this+0xC; the returned success value gates the field clear.
Clear the second handle field at this+0xC to 0 when the CloseHandle call succeeds.
Return the result of the second CloseHandle attempt (or the flag value when the second close is skipped).

unresolved: The kernel object type the two handles refer to is unknown; the flag fields at this+0x14 and this+0x24 gate each close individually.
